name: 40342 · Lawrenceburg, KY
findings: ZIP 40342 (Lawrenceburg) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40342 (Lawrenceburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
